2577-7084-8250-8345.easyPrerequisites:

2577-7084-8250-8345.description:

Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.

2105-3499-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.

2105-3499-5895-8330.description:

When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.

Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

Activate the other creature using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.

678-3967-4939.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1

Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.

1981-2415-3845-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3703-5627-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
3703-5627-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.

751-1741-5778-6747.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries with offspring by paying {1}{U} using the cost reduction from Sami.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries abilities, untapping two lands.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When the token copy of Cloud of Faeries enters, its ability triggers, untapping two lands.
Activate four lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake with offspring by paying {U}, using cost reduction from Sami.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries to its owner's hand.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Shrieking Drake.
When the token copy of Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers, returning the nontoken Shrieking Drake to its owner's hand.
Repeat.
751-1741-5778-6747.notes: Once infinite mana has been generated, the Shrieking Drake can return any creature other than Zinnia to hand to recast infinitely.

1619-4605-5542-6151-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6151-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6151-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

240-2921-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

2103-4013-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.

Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Eldrazi Displacer.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4149-4599-4871-6019-7060.description:

When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

372-673-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-673-7487.description:

Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

997-3175-5617.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2404-4499-7008.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2404-4499-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}.
When Badgermole Cub enters, it triggers, earthbending Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}

Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Badgermole Cub.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2730-5987.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alchemist's Gambit spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alchemist's Gambit and returning the original Alchemist's Gambit to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alchemist's Gambit from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

When Ugin's Nexus enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 4.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.

Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a creature token.

Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.

When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.

When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Walk the Aeons to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

"Zombie" chosen with Engineered Plague.
